counterhypotheses.proposition: Content-addressed opaque semantic preservation plus one generic downstream consumer is sufficient; class-by-class legality/disposition adds ceremony without correctness benefit.
counterhypotheses.support_search: compiler IR partial lowering and unknown-op handling
counterhypotheses.discriminator: Run all 10 residual classes through generic versus explicit-disposition WP04/05 implementations with semantic mutation, unsupported-class, fail-closed and authority-minting controls; compare silent-loss rate, diagnostics, code complexity and resources.

counterhypotheses.proposition: Multiple derived routing views from one canonical substrate are sufficient if reconciliation and anti-entropy are strong; ancestry-diverse views are unnecessary.
counterhypotheses.support_search: incremental materialized views and reconciliation systems
counterhypotheses.discriminator: Inject upstream-shared and view-local edge faults; compare correlated dual-view, independently derived audit-view, and dense broadcast at equal correctness/cost.

counterhypotheses.proposition: A diversified relevance retriever plus model-side critical reasoning recovers counterevidence well enough; a dedicated contradiction retriever mainly raises false-conflict noise and cost.
counterhypotheses.discriminator: Frozen hypothesis corpus with known supports/refutations: relevance-only, diversified hybrid, and explicit contradiction lane; measure contradiction recall, false-conflict rate, calibration, downstream decision reversals and cost.

counterhypotheses.against: owner-fixed omnisource intake direction / V3 backprop mechanism
counterhypotheses.proposition: Feeding every registered new observation through materiality/fusion/re-entry creates recursive coordination noise and stale invalidation pressure that can cost more than periodic bounded refresh.
counterhypotheses.support_search: stream-processing backpressure, incremental maintenance cost, event deduplication/replay
counterhypotheses.discriminator: Matched periodic-batch versus omnisource-incremental replay at equal source coverage; measure missed material deltas, false materiality, re-entry latency, duplicate suppression, branch interrupts and total CPU/RAM/I/O/network/token cost.
